spots.name: Mount Torbert
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,479 m (11,415 ft).

spots.name: Mount Spurr
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 3,374 m (11,070 ft).

spots.name: Portage Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Shamrock Lake
spots.tip: A lake: calm air at dawn gives mirror reflections, and mist often sits on the water on cold mornings. The pin marks the middle of the lake: pick a shore spot facing the light.
